title: USA Business Formation Action Planner
description: Unified action planner for navigating USA business formation and operations

phases.name: Business Concept & Planning
phases.description: Define your business idea and create foundational plans

actions.title: Conduct Market Research
actions.description: Analyze market needs, competition, and target customers

actions.title: Identify Business Opportunity
actions.description: Define your value proposition and business concept

actions.title: Develop Business Plan
actions.description: Create comprehensive business plan with goals, strategies, and financial projections

actions.title: Assess Funding Requirements
actions.description: Determine capital needs and explore funding options

actions.title: Evaluate Risks
actions.description: Identify and assess business risks with mitigation strategies

phases.name: Legal Structure & Registration
phases.description: Choose and establish your business legal structure

actions.title: Choose Business Structure
actions.description: Select between LLC, Corporation, Partnership, or Sole Proprietorship based on liability and tax considerations

actions.title: Register Business Name
actions.description: File DBA or register legal business name with state

actions.title: Obtain EIN (Employer Identification Number)
actions.description: Apply for federal tax ID from IRS for tax purposes

actions.title: File Formation Documents
actions.description: Submit Articles of Organization/Incorporation to state

actions.title: Obtain Required Permits
actions.description: Apply for industry-specific permits and local business permits

phases.name: Compliance & Licensing
phases.description: Obtain required licenses and ensure regulatory compliance

actions.title: Obtain Business Licenses
actions.description: Apply for required local, state, and federal licenses

actions.title: Register for State Taxes
actions.description: Register with state tax authority for sales tax, employer taxes, and franchise tax

actions.title: Set Up Compliance Systems
actions.description: Establish processes for ongoing compliance requirements and regulatory tracking

actions.title: Understand Federal Regulations
actions.description: Review applicable federal regulations for your industry

actions.title: Open Business Bank Account
actions.description: Separate personal and business finances with dedicated accounts

actions.title: Set Up Accounting System
actions.description: Implement bookkeeping and accounting processes with proper controls

actions.title: Obtain Business Insurance
actions.description: Secure appropriate insurance coverage for liability and risks

actions.title: Establish Operating Agreements
actions.description: Create bylaws, operating agreements, or partnership agreements

actions.title: Set Up Technology Systems
actions.description: Implement technology infrastructure for business operations

phases.name: Growth & Scaling
phases.description: Implement growth strategies and scale operations

actions.title: Develop Marketing Strategy
actions.description: Create and implement marketing and customer acquisition plan

actions.title: Build Team
actions.description: Hire employees or engage contractors as needed for growth

actions.title: Monitor Compliance & Reporting
actions.description: Maintain ongoing compliance with annual reports and filings

actions.title: Scale Operations
actions.description: Expand business operations based on growth metrics and market demand

actions.title: Develop New Products/Services
actions.description: Innovate and expand product or service offerings
